thread:
liam: Heads up — trying to stitch together a cross-repo merge that touches sdk, api, console, and helm charts. PRs: sdk <https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/1234>, api <https://github.com/redwood/api/pull/987>, console <https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/555>, charts <https://github.com/redwood/charts/pull/42>. Need approvals from @eva (SDK), @sanjay (API), @rachel (charts). CI looks green locally but console e2e is flaky on auth header. Targeting TOMORROW 09:30 PT merge window — can folks do quick reviews and callouts?
jamie: re: console flake — seen that before. I have a small fix for the timing race, pushing now. ETA ~2h.
eva: on sdk PR — quick pass done. two tiny nits (naming + docstring). Also prefer keeping legacy env var for one release for backwards compat. I can approve after that change.
sanjay: API PR mostly fine but we bumped response schema for /v1/session. Need an API_CHANGE note and a short migration snippet in api/UPGRADING.md. Will approve once that's added.
rachel: charts need a patch version bump and I want to validate that runtime helm values still work (esp cache.enabled toggle). If you add chart version + brief changelog I'll approve.
liam: thanks. I'll push the sdk nits and add the upgrading note to API. Jamie — when your console patch is in, can you re-run e2e? If tests still flaky, do we want to hold main merge and canary to dedicated first?
alex: I can do a manual canary deploy to dedicated and run the smoke tests if needed. Ping me when all PRs are green.
deploy-bot: sdk PR 1234 merged to staging by ci-bot (auto-merge due to team approvals)
jamie: pushed console patch, retriggered CI: <https://app.ci/console/555/builds/789>.
ci: console-e2e failed in 2/3 shards with auth header timeout. Logs: <https://app.ci/logs/console/555/789>. Looks timing-related (token refresh/clock skew).
sanjay: added migration snippet to api PR and note in api/UPGRADING.md. Also left a comment on the schema bump to ensure clients get a deprecation window.
eva: approved sdk PR (1234) — thanks, liam.
rachel: chart version bumped to 0.3.5 and pushed to charts PR. Running chart-lint in CI.
liam: sweet. Plan: merge sdk + api first (they're independent) at 09:30 PT, then watch canary on dedicated. If console e2e stabilizes we merge console+charts afterwards; if not, proceed with console canary deploy only. @alex you'll get a ping for canary smoke.
alex: lgtm, will standby and document post-canary checks (startup logs, 503 counts, auth errors). :thumbsup: 
liam: thanks everyone — will send a quick thread update when I start merging. If anyone sees anything blocking, shout here or DM.
